def merge_sorted_list(list1, list2, list3):
    """
    Merges three input lists into a single sorted list in ascending order.
    
    Args:
        list1 (list): First list of numbers.
        list2 (list): Second list of numbers.
        list3 (list): Third list of numbers.
        
    Returns:
        list: A new list containing all elements from the inputs, sorted in ascending order.
    """
    # Combine all three lists and sort them immediately
    return sorted(list1 + list2 + list3)

# Verification with your specific test case
if __name__ == "__main__":
    l1 = [25, 24, 15, 4, 5, 29, 110]
    l2 = [19, 20, 11, 56, 25, 233, 154]
    l3 = [24, 26, 54, 48]

    result = merge_sorted_list(l1, l2, l3)
    
    expected = [4, 5, 11, 15, 19, 20, 24, 24, 25, 25, 26, 29, 48, 54, 56, 110, 154, 233]
    
    assert result == expected, f"Test failed! Got {result}"
    print("All tests passed!")
